As a result, the FY2022 10-K restates FY2020 revenue (for comparative purposes, continuing operations only) at $55,179 million [DOC-2], which excludes Kyndryl's contribution.

Using the two continuing-operations figures that are presented on a comparable basis in the same filing (DOC-2): FY2020 = $55,179 million and FY2022 = $60,530 million.

Growth = ($60,530M − $55,179M) / $55,179M ≈ 9.70%

Note: This growth rate reflects continuing operations only (post-Kyndryl spin-off basis) and is not comparable to the originally reported FY2020 total revenue of $73,620 million, which included Kyndryl's managed infrastructure services business.

ANSWER: Approximately 9.7% growth (from $55,179M to $60,530M) on a comparable continuing-operations basis; not comparable to the originally reported FY2020 figure of $73,620M due to the Kyndryl spin-off/discontinued-operations restatement.
